Understood?
Sir, yes sir!
I've got your Daily Orders, read them carefully!
Be vigilant! Enemy spy is still roaming our sub. Pay close attention to details.
Sir yes sir! I will give my best!
We have a lot to do. I don't want you catching flies, be very careful with the messages!
Yes sir, maximum precaution and focus, sir!
You'd better...
Wake up, no time for sleep!
There's a lot of communication coming through, I bet most of which is from our enemies.
Oh, so it IS authentic. Nice!
Yes sir, I will be accurate. We do need those supplies for sure.
Hello, how's Obscura working these days? Still giving you troubles?
No sir, everything in order!
Good. Check this verification message, I need clear confirmation whether the message we've received is true or false.
Well, you may ask but I may not tell you. Here is the message.
Are you busy? I need this message verified, as fast as possible. I have a gut feeling something is not right.
May I ask what the message was about?
Don't get up. I have a small task for you, are you busy?
Not at all, sir. Tell me, how may I help you?
Take this verification message. Something is fishy and I don't have that machine room stench in mind.
I will verify it at once, sir!
I was told that you are mostly catching sleep around here.
I see that was exaggerated a bit. But still, I need you fully awake for this one.
Something is strange with this message. Check it out and let me know if it's real or fake.
Sir, right away sir!
Working on something important at the moment?
No sir, I am free, how may I help you?
We received a message some time ago. Some dipstick forgot to authenticate it. I need you to process this verification message, just to be sure.
Yes sir. It wasn't me sir, I can assure you.
Something is fishy with this message. I don't have in mind that stench from engine room. Something ominous with this particular message, verify it and give it back to me.
Doesn't matter now, just check this message and let me know if it's true or false.
Quite sure sir, double checked.
Alright, thank you.
Whom, sir?
Doesn't matter, carry on with your duties.
Fake message, sir!
Fake? I knew it. Damn Western Kingdom. And their radio transmitters.
What, a fake one?
I'm afraid so.
If you've made a mistake you should be afraid, it's important!
Well, I expected it to be fake, but I was not sure.
I hope it's not something important.
It is, at least partially. Nothing to do with you, so no worries.
Fake message sir, doesn't check out properly.
Fake...it figures. OK, off I go then. Carry on with your tasks.
Sir?
Sir what?
You were saying...
I am glad that it's authentic. Otherwise I'd be in a hell lot of trouble.
Are you absolutely sure that this is authentic?
Yes sir, I've paid attention and made sure everything is in order.
No chance that you've made a mistake?
Well sir, there is always a chance, do you want me to double check it?
No need, I have other priorities. Thank you.
True?
Yes sir!
Someone in counter-intelligence is slacking, that's for sure. That's your branch by the way.
Well I don't know sir, I don't have the actual message at hand.
And you won't. Anyway, thank you, off I go.
I'm not glad that this is true. Not one little bit.
May I ask sir, why?
No you may not. Carry on with your duties.
What, TRUE ECHO?
Yes sir.
Are you sure?
Yes sir, positive!
Dammit.
What, true!?
I have to find the slacker who didn't report this message in time. Now it's too late to take action.
Dammit!
Oh, authentic message? Excellent.
Yes sir, glad to be of help.
Thank you, carry on with your duties.
I have a message that needs to be encoded. Don't bother with the text, just hurry up.
Sir, right on it!
Sir!
At ease. I have a message that needs to go through your Obscura. Encode it and give me back the encoded output paper.
Yes sir!
That machine of yours still working?
Which one, sir?
Obscura. I've heard you had some power issues.
Not sure where you heard that from, sir. It's working perfectly.
Great, encode this message for me, will you?
Don't stand up. I have a message for encoding.
Is everything in order sir? All prerequisites?
You tell me. Here is the message.
Sir!
At ease. I have a message for encoding. Don't bother with the text, just make sure you don't make mistakes like last time.
Last time, sir?
Hurry up, I haven't got all day.
What do you mean FALSE ECHO?
Sir, I need proper authorization as per regulations written in...
Don't YOU teach me what regulations are! I am a senior officer here!
What now? Something missing?
Yes sir, I am under strict regulations as per Daily Orders.
That's a pity. But understandable.
Why is this FALSE ECHO? Now I cannot send this forth.
Sir, I have to follow strict guidelines by the Daily Orders.
Alright, continue with your duties.
False? I am missing something?
Yes sir, stamps need to be in order, please correct the message and come back with them.
OK, we need to stick to the rules!
Excellent, you are not as slow as they say.
Doing my best, sir!
Let's hope you didn't make too many mistakes.
If you did I will make sure you lose one Oppark for each wrong letter!
Good, see, that wasn't that hard. I will take this to Harvey.
Thank you!
You are welcome, sir!
You are sure that there are no mistakes?
I did my best sir!
Doing one's best is not the same as doing what is required. In Oppressia we take only the best and squash the rest.
Ehr, yes sir!
All done?
Yes sir, message is encoded, your input plain text message is archived securely.
Good. Be faster next time, will you?
Yes sir!
Well that's one thing off my shoulders. I will take this to our radioman.
Yes sir!
Here you go sir, message processed according to rules and regulations.
Good, no mistakes made?
None that I am aware of, no.
Great. Carry on then.
At ease. I have here a message that needs decoding.
I will get right on it, sir!
Hurry up, I have other things to attend to.
Our famous encryption officer. Don't bother standing up, I have a task for you.
Yes sir!
Decode this message. I don't know what it is, let's see if Obscura sheds some light.
Decoding task for you, shake up a bit.
Yes sir?
Here is the message, make sure you decode with care.
This fell out of some stacks of paper, I need it properly decoded, it could be important.
Sir, under Oppressian Navy Regulations, section 5C I am required to report behavior which...
Just decode the damn message. If anyone is going to report anything, that'd be me. You: turn that Obscura and do your job.
I have an encrypted message that requires decoding.
Yes sir, give it to me, I will see what I can do.
Take this message and see what it is all about. I need it decoded fast.
Yes sir, I will get right on it.
Sir!
At ease. Take this message and decode it.
It dropped behind Panel 5, probably during that last depth charge attack.
Yes sir, I will do it right away.
How do you mean a false message?
It did not meet the criteria, sir!
Dammit.
Fake message?
Yes sir.
What am I supposed to do with it then... dammit. I hate when this happens.
What, a fake message?
Yes sir.
How?
It did not meet the criteria set by Naval regulations in order to comply with...
Forget it, I have other things to do.
What, a fake one?
Yes sir, I double checked everything.
Ah great, dammit.
All in order?
Yes sir, here is the decoded message.
Thank you. Keep up the good work.
Sir, your message is here.
Good. Is everything in order?
Yes sir, all good.
Great, carry on with your duties.
Oh, you have decoded it?
Yes sir, here it is.
What do you think of the message contents?
I haven't paid attention sir, that's not for me to analyze nor decide.
Very good, very very good. Carry on.
All in order?
Yes sir, message decoded well and processed according to standing orders.
Good, keep up the good work.
Ready already? You didn't trade accuracy for speed, I hope.
No sir, I did it according to the standing rules.
Good, I'd hate to come back and have different kind of talk.
Is it ready?
Yes sir, message decoded.
OK. I will take some time to analyze it properly before making our next move. Carry on.
Sir, I have a verification message to be checked.
At ease. Who is it from?
I don't know sir, I've been ordered to bring it to you for authentification.
Alright, give me the message.
Sir, new verification message, can you please check it?
Yes, of course, give it to me.
Sir, reporting a verification message that must be authenticated, sir!
OK, what's the message about?
I don't know sir. I am just a messenger, sir!
Nice and cozy cabin, sir. Sorry for bothering you but there is a message that requires authentication.
It's not that cozy as you might think. What kind of message?
A verification slip sir. Officers at the bridge ordered me to bring it to you.
Alright, give it to me.
New verification message, sir!
Take it easy sailor. Where is the message?
It's here, sir, sorry for bursting like that.
Sir, may I come in?
Yes, come in, do you need some help?
Yes sir, there is a message, a verification slip, that must be authenticated. Can you do it now sir?
I can, I am free. Any specifics?
No sir. XO sent me and told me to verify it before the main message is taken into consideration. Something to do with patrol course change.
OK, give me the message and I will see what I can do.
Permission to speak sir.
Granted. Go ahead.
I have a verification message that needs your attention. Can you please check its authenticity?
If it's an official one, yeah, sure, give it to me.
Fake message, sir?
Yes, FALSE ECHO.
I'm in trouble now.
Thank you sir, permission to leave?
Go ahead.
Sir, message is fake?
Afraid so. It did not fulfill the requirements.
OK sir, I will take it to my superior officer. Thank you.
A fake message sir?
Yes, not authentic.
Thank you sir, I will take it back to XO.
There you go sailor, it's a fake communication.
Roger that sir.
Permission to leave sir?
Permission granted, go ahead.
Sir, am I right to say that this is a fake message?
